In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of vaccines for the treatment of drug addiction.
the development of an effective heroin vaccine.

the development of a simple and nonradio-active method to accurately measure the apparent dissociated constant (Kd), a measure of the binding affinity, of polyclonal antibodies in sera to heroin and its metabolites 6-AM (heroin's primary metabolite) and morphine (6- AM's primary metabolite).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this is the first report of a solution-based method to quantify heroin- antibody binding without being confunded by 6-AM or morphine.
this method has been successfully applied to determine the Kd of antibodies to heroin, and 6-AM.

this method has the ability to measure antibody affinities to heroin, 5-AM and morphin, which are the three major metabolites of heroin, and can be extended to the development of vaccines for other drugs of abuse.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of deuterium-labaled drug tracers in ED-UPLC-MS/MS to determine the binding affinits of antibodies induced by TT-hapten conjugates for drugs of abused is a simple and nonradioative alternative to radioimmunoassay (RIA) and ELISA.

the ED-UPLC-MS/MS method is a simple, nonradioactive, and sensitive method for the determination and comparison of the binding affinites of polyclonal antibodies induced by hapen bioconjugates to heroin, 5-AM, and/or morphine.
the use of competition ED-UPLCs/MS/MS to measure Kd values for antibodies induced by hapen bioconjugates is an important step forward in the development of vaccines to drugs of abuse.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of deuterated drug tracers in combination with ED and UPLC/MS can be used to accurately measure the apparent Kd of antibodies to heroin and other drugs of abuse.

competition ED-UPLCM/MS/MS can be used to measure the binding of antibodies to heroin, and that TT-6-AcmorHap is a better hapten design for the induction of high affinity antibodies to morphine than TT-MorHAP.
the Kd values measured by competition ED-UPLCMS/MS are more accurate than IC50 values determined by competition ELISA.
